definition: A weaker, potentially reductionist use of the word soul in which it designates the coordinated powers or organization of a living system, without adding an irreducible intrinsic formal principle. The toy model locates those features in its observable predicates instead of counting them as its distinct SoulAsForm predicate.
note: Comparative terminology only (#329), not attributed to a particular author. Whether a particular hylomorphist's form is functionally reducible is a separate source and metaphysical question.
